_meta.source: Spelling.pdf — Spelling Dictionary word bank (P. Olivieri / Rockin Resources), letter A section, pages 3-4
_meta.audience: Middle school students (ages 11-14), Lake Drive School for Deaf and Hard of Hearing Children

words.sentence: I am able to carry all these books.
words.scene: A confident middle-school student carrying a tall stack of textbooks with one arm, standing straight and smiling, giving a small nod; a soft glow line shows effortless strength
A student holding an open book toward the viewer; the visible page clearly shows a large illustrated shark; the student points at the shark page with one finger

words.sentence: The kite flies above the tree.
words.scene: A bright red diamond kite floating high in the sky directly above a single green tree, with a clear vertical gap of open sky between them and a simple upward arrow at the left

words.sentence: It was an accident. The paint spilled.
words.scene: A tipped-over can of blue paint spreading a puddle across a classroom floor, a student standing beside it with wide eyes and both hands raised in surprise
A student walking across a small wooden footbridge over a stream, shown from the side, with a dashed arrow tracing the path from one bank to the other

words.sentence: I act in the school play.
words.scene: A student on a small stage in costume, arms raised mid-performance, red stage curtains behind and a warm spotlight circle on the floor
A student at a whiteboard writing the equation 2 + 3 = 5 with a marker, pointing at the plus sign
A math worksheet on a desk showing a neat column of addition problems with large plus signs, a pencil resting on it and a student's hand solving one

words.sentence: Write the address on the envelope.
words.scene: A white envelope with clearly written lines of a mailing address and a stamp, held up in front of a house with a numbered mailbox

words.sentence: We had an adventure in the mountains.
words.scene: A teen hiker with a backpack standing on a mountain trail holding an open paper map, tall peaks and pine trees ahead

words.sentence: He is afraid of the dark hallway.
words.scene: A student standing at the edge of a dim hallway, shoulders pulled up, hands clasped at chest, nervous expression, cool shadows ahead

words.sentence: I brush my teeth after dinner.
words.scene: A two-panel sequence separated by a thin arrow: left panel a student eating at a dinner plate, right panel the same student brushing teeth at a sink
Students walking out of a school building under a bright mid-afternoon sun, a large wall clock in the sky area reading 3:00

words.sentence: We played soccer, and afterward we ate pizza.
words.scene: A two-panel sequence separated by a thin arrow: left panel two teens kicking a soccer ball, right panel the same two teens sharing a pizza at a table

words.sentence: She tried again and made the shot.
words.scene: A student shooting a basketball into a hoop, with a curved circular arrow beside them showing a repeated attempt and a small ghosted outline of the first try

words.sentence: My bike leans against the wall.
words.scene: A bicycle leaning at an angle against a red brick wall, side view, clear contact point between tire, frame and wall
A smiling teen behind a birthday cake with candles shaped as the number 13, party setting
A wall calendar with today's date marked and a curved arrow pointing backward to a date circled seven days earlier

words.sentence: He is ahead in the race.
words.scene: Three student runners on a track seen from the side, the leading runner clearly in front with a forward arrow above them and a finish line ahead

words.sentence: The balloon is full of air.
words.scene: A student blowing into a large balloon, cheeks puffed, with curved motion lines showing air moving into the balloon

words.sentence: The airplane flies in the sky.
words.scene: A passenger airplane in flight, side three-quarter view, against a blue sky with a few rounded clouds below
An airport terminal with tall windows, two parked airplanes at gates outside, and travelers rolling suitcases inside
Two identical sneakers side by side on a plain surface with a large equals sign between them
A small green seedling with two bright leaves growing from brown soil, a ladybug on one leaf, sun rays above
A bowl containing a full bunch of grapes with a wide circle drawn around the entire bowl to show the whole group

words.sentence: The teacher allowed us to go outside.
words.scene: A teacher smiling and handing a hall pass to a student while gesturing toward an open door, a green check mark beside them

words.sentence: Are you all right? Yes, I am all right.
words.scene: A student who has just stood up after a small stumble, brushing off their sleeve and giving a clear thumbs-up with a reassuring smile
A tall clear glass filled with water nearly to the top, with a small visible gap of empty space and a thin dashed line marking the rim

words.sentence: She sat alone and read a book.
words.scene: A single student sitting at one end of a long empty park bench reading a book, plenty of empty space on either side
A student walking on a path that runs beside a winding river, viewed from the side, with a dashed line following the path's direction

words.sentence: There are a lot of books here.
words.scene: A very tall stack of colorful books towering on a table beside a small student who looks up at it
A student holding up a completed worksheet marked with a green check while a wall clock shows early evening, a closed backpack at their feet

words.sentence: I have a sandwich and also an apple.
words.scene: A school lunch tray holding a sandwich on the left and an apple on the right with a large plus sign between them

words.sentence: Although it rained, she rode her bike.
words.scene: A student in a yellow raincoat cheerfully riding a bicycle through light rain, puddles splashing, gray rain clouds above but a confident smile
A row of three calendar squares each showing the same sunrise over the same house, each marked with a check, and a repeating circular arrow above
A student pointing at their own chest with a thumb, wearing a name tag that reads MAYA, smiling directly at the viewer
A simple outline map of the United States filled with red and blue, with a waving American flag beside it and the Statue of Liberty in the background

words.sentence: One red apple is among the green apples.
words.scene: A group of green apples arranged together on a table with a single bright red apple in the middle of them and an arrow pointing to the red one

words.sentence: I like peanut butter and jelly.
words.scene: A jar of peanut butter on the left and a jar of jelly on the right with a large plus sign between them and a sandwich below
A teen with arms tightly crossed, eyebrows pulled down, mouth in a firm frown, with two small cartoon steam puffs rising from the sides of the head
A friendly group of four animals together: a dog, a rabbit, a turtle and a small bird, arranged in a row on grass
A plate with cookies where one has already been taken, a hand reaching in to take one more, with a small plus one symbol
A student sitting at a desk with hand raised high, a speech bubble above containing a large green check mark, a teacher nodding nearby
A row of five different colored markers on a desk with an open hand hovering above them, undecided, small question marks over each
A student holding a heavy box turning toward a group of classmates, a large question mark above, several classmates beginning to raise their hands
A classroom where one student holds a single pencil up high in the air while others look toward them, a small question mark above the asking student

words.sentence: You can put anything in this backpack.
words.scene: An open backpack with many different objects floating out of it: a pencil, a soccer ball, an apple, a notebook and a water bottle

words.sentence: The umbrella broke, but she walked anyway.
words.scene: A student walking forward in the rain holding a clearly broken bent umbrella, still smiling and stepping confidently

words.sentence: I eat an apple every day.
words.scene: A single bright red apple with a green leaf on its stem, resting on a wooden desktop, centered and clean
A calendar page with the heading APRIL and a grid of dates, surrounded by falling raindrops and blooming tulips
Three teens standing close together with arms around each other's shoulders, all smiling at the viewer
Two clearly different shoes side by side, one a blue sneaker and one a brown boot, with a large red X between them and an unequal look
Two teens standing face to face with hands out in disagreement, each with a jagged zigzag speech bubble above their head, frustrated but not violent
A classroom chalkboard covered with large plus, minus, multiplication and division symbols and simple number problems
A teen standing and flexing one bent arm upward, with a thin pointer line labeling the arm from shoulder to hand
An oval running track seen from above at an angle with a student running on it and a large circular arrow following the loop
A wooden easel holding a colorful painting, with a paint palette, brushes in a jar and a student painting beside it

words.sentence: He is as tall as his friend.
words.scene: Two students standing back to back at exactly the same height with a horizontal dashed measuring line running level across the tops of both heads

words.sentence: I asked my teacher a question.
words.scene: A student with hand raised at a desk, a speech bubble above containing a large question mark, a teacher turning to listen
A teen sleeping peacefully in a bed under a blanket, eyes closed, with three floating Z letters rising above the pillow and a dark window
An astronaut in a white spacesuit and reflective helmet floating in dark space with stars and the curved blue Earth behind

words.sentence: I waited at the bus stop.
words.scene: A student standing directly beside a bus stop sign on a sidewalk with a red location pin marker floating above their head
An empty plate with only a few crumbs and a fork resting on it, a satisfied student sitting behind it patting their stomach
A calendar page with the heading AUGUST and a grid of dates, with a bright sun, a beach ball and a sand pail beside it
A warm adult woman hugging a smiling teenager in a living room doorway, a suitcase beside her
A clean blue four-door sedan car parked on a driveway, three-quarter front view, clearly showing wheels, windows and doors
A tree with orange and red leaves, several leaves drifting down through the air, and a raked pile of leaves on the ground
A teen sitting upright in bed with eyes wide open and arms stretching, a ringing alarm clock on the nightstand and morning sunlight through the window
A student on a sidewalk waving goodbye as a yellow school bus drives off into the distance, with a long arrow pointing away toward the horizon
A teen pinching their nose and leaning back from a plate of burnt blackened food on a table, with wavy green stink lines rising from the plate

words.sentence: We waited awhile for the bus.
words.scene: A student sitting on a bench at a bus stop looking at a wristwatch, with a large hourglass floating beside them showing sand running down
